root_cause_label: Missing CSV Header in Final Output
one_sentence_failure_summary: The awk script in solution.sh correctly extracts top-3 magnitude bins per frame but never emits the required 'frame,f1_bin,f2_bin,f3_bin' header row in peaks.csv, and all subsequent verification checks focus only on data values and ordering, never inspecting the header.
t_err_evidence: I'll create solution.sh that orchestrates the pipeline and uses awk to extract the top 3 spectral peaks per frame
t_commit_evidence: In step 9, the agent runs 'head -20 /app/data/peaks.csv' and observes the first line is '0,14,21,28' with no header row. The agent notes the file 'has 184 lines (one per frame)' and concludes the format is correct without noticing the missing header, proceeding to verify data values only for the remainder of the trajectory.
t_surface_evidence: peaks appear to be consistent across frames (bins 14, 21, 28)
trigger_explanation: The task spec requires peaks.csv to have a 'frame,f1_bin,f2_bin,f3_bin' header row. The agent understood the column schema (it references it in analysis comments) but when writing the awk script in step 3, it only handled skipping the input mag.csv header ('NR > 1') and never added a corresponding output header print statement. This is a failure to carry through an explicit spec requirement into the implementation.
